text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho. Satono Diamond 
remained composed, never once uttering a 
word about the jinx today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She remained focused even in the paddock. 
Kitasan Black, who was watching, gave her 
full endorsement, confident that everyone 
would witness her finest run.
